proof.scope:
Certify declared six-suite TLS captures against wire, peer receipts and WS.

The owned profiles use distinct TCP endpoint pairs and complete IPv4 captures.
All TLS record bytes and contributing frame references must match independently
reconstructed TCP bytes. HTTP plaintext must equal the independent OpenSSL peer
transcript; available reference wire records and HTTP bodies are compared too.
This does not certify every TLS version, extension, resumption or TCP boundary.

Compare complete public SDK events across the capture-clock correction.

Pair by literal bytes, contributors, capture domain, transport endpoints and both
flow namespaces. Only generated event/PDU-ID aliases may be renumbered. The six
new unprotected zero tails and source-bound fragment diagnostics are adjudicated
separately. No application field or arbitrary wire integer is normalized.
proof.scope_limit: Fragment diagnostics are source-bound observations and conservative resource/expiry outcomes; invalid IP version rows remain explicit defects and do not certify valid fragment admission or full Wireshark parity.
